challenges.title: Split a bill exactly
challenges.prompt: Implement splitBill(billCents, tipPercent, people) working in whole cents: validate the input (ArgumentError), compute the total with tip rounded to a cent, and split it so shares differ by at most one cent and add up exactly to the total.
challenges.explain: Money should be handled as integers (cents); the first `remainder` people pay one extra cent so the shares sum exactly instead of losing or inventing a cent to rounding. Verified by running the solution with the Dart SDK.

challenges.title: A path matcher with route guards
challenges.prompt: Implement match(pattern, path) returning the :param map when every segment matches (decoding percent-escapes), else null. The route() function then applies a login guard and renders the matching page, like a minimal go_router.
challenges.explain: Declarative routing is a function from the URL (and auth state) to what is on screen: guards redirect first, then path patterns with :params select the page. Verified by running the solution with the Dart SDK.
